key_insight: SwarmLink adds peer-to-peer coordination to multi-UAV missions so photovoltaic inspections can keep reallocating sensing work at runtime despite platform failures or poor data quality.
engineering_relevance: This enables resilient large-scale solar plant inspection without relying on a single ground-station coordinator, improving coverage continuity and mission robustness.
method: Non-invasively extends Aerostack2 with inter-agent communication
Uses a distributed auction to assign sensing targets among active UAVs
Re-auctions remaining targets to recover from failures and unusable captures
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a photovoltaic plant inspection case study where the same runtime mechanism handles initial allocation, platform-failure recovery, and data-quality-triggered reassignment.
watch_item: The approach depends on reliable peer-to-peer communication and auction timing, so network delays or intermittent links could affect coordination performance.
paper_title: Distributed Coordination for Resilient Multi-UAV Remote Sensing: A Photovoltaic Inspection Case Study
